title: Port Credit Harbour Marina
specs: Located at the mouth of the Credit River in Port Credit, Ontario, between Toronto and Oakville
Marina occupies 18 acres of land and 49 acres of water on the Mississauga waterfront
Marina Lease Agreement and Boat Questionnaire Form must be fully completed and signed before storage or docking

No major overhauls, spray painting, sandblasting, sodablasting, structural repairs, woodworking, hull or keel repairs, fiberglass repairs, or engine repairs allowed on site unless performed by on-site repair centre or approved contractor
Evidence of property and liability insurance coverage required for winter storage

blurb: Port Credit Harbour Marina occupies 18 acres of land and 49 acres of water on the Mississauga waterfront. It offers more than 500 slips, seasonal docking, indoor storage, and a range of marine services including boat cleaning, repairs, and sales. The marina is conveniently located near shops, restaurants, and transit.
